package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const (
	defaultKnowledgeImportBatchMaxOperations = 10_000
	defaultKnowledgeImportBatchMaxBodyBytes  = 64 << 20
	batchFailureBodyLimit                    = 64 << 10
)

var knowledgeImportWritePaths = map[string][]*regexp.Regexp{
	http.MethodPost: {
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/(?:course|track|level|course-group|module|section|lesson|task)/create$`),
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/course-i18n/create/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$`),
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/(?:track-relations/add-level|level-relations/add-course-group|course-group-relations/add-course|course-relations/add-module|module-relations/add-section|section-relations/add-lesson)/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$`),
	},
	http.MethodPut: {
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/(?:course|track|level|course-group|module|section|lesson|task)/update/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$`),
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/course-relations/update-(?:tags|techs)/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$`),
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/(?:track-relations/replace-levels|level-relations/replace-course-groups|course-group-relations/replace-courses)/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$`),
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/(?:course-relations/replace-modules|module-relations/replace-sections|section-relations/replace-lessons)/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$`),
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/(?:lesson-relations/replace|lesson-examples/replace|example-relations/replace)/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$`),
	},
	http.MethodDelete: {
		regexp.MustCompile(`^/task/delete/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$`),
	},
}

type knowledgeImportBatchOperation struct {
	Method string          `json:"method"`
	Path   string          `json:"path"`
	Body   json.RawMessage `json:"body"`
}

type knowledgeImportBatchRequest struct {
	Operations []knowledgeImportBatchOperation `json:"operations"`
}

type knowledgeImportBatchFailure struct {
	Index      int
	Method     string
	Path       string
	StatusCode int
	Response   string
}

func (e *knowledgeImportBatchFailure) Error() string {
	message := fmt.Sprintf("operation %d (%s %s) failed with status %d", e.Index, e.Method, e.Path, e.StatusCode)
	if e.Response != "" {
		message += ": " + e.Response
	}
	return message
}

// KnowledgeImportBatchHandler executes an allowlisted sequence of existing
// admin writes in one outer database transaction.
type KnowledgeImportBatchHandler struct {
	Tx            repository.TransactionManager
	Dispatch      http.Handler
	MaxOperations int
	MaxBodyBytes  int64
}

// Apply handles POST /knowledge-import/batch.
func (h *KnowledgeImportBatchHandler) Apply(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h == nil || h.Tx == nil || h.Dispatch == nil {
		http.Error(w, "knowledge import batch is unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}

	maxBodyBytes := h.MaxBodyBytes
	if maxBodyBytes <= 0 {
		maxBodyBytes = defaultKnowledgeImportBatchMaxBodyBytes
	}
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, maxBodyBytes)
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var request knowledgeImportBatchRequest
	if err := decoder.Decode(&request); err != nil {
		var maxBytesError *http.MaxBytesError
		if errors.As(err, &maxBytesError) {
			writeKnowledgeImportBatchError(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "batch_too_large", err.Error(), nil)
			return
		}
		writeKnowledgeImportBatchError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_batch", err.Error(), nil)
		return
	}
	if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
		writeKnowledgeImportBatchError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_batch", err.Error(), nil)
		return
	}

	maxOperations := h.MaxOperations
	if maxOperations <= 0 {
		maxOperations = defaultKnowledgeImportBatchMaxOperations
	}
	if len(request.Operations) == 0 || len(request.Operations) > maxOperations {
		writeKnowledgeImportBatchError(
			w,
			http.StatusUnprocessableEntity,
			"invalid_batch",
			fmt.Sprintf("operations must contain between 1 and %d items", maxOperations),
			nil,
		)
		return
	}
	for index, operation := range request.Operations {
		if err := validateKnowledgeImportOperation(operation); err != nil {
			writeKnowledgeImportBatchError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_operation", err.Error(), &index)
			return
		}
	}

	err := h.Tx.WithTx(r.Context(), func(ctx repository.Context) error {
		for index, operation := range request.Operations {
			body := bytes.NewReader(operation.Body)
			operationContext := context.WithValue(ctx, chi.RouteCtxKey, chi.NewRouteContext())
			subrequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(operationContext, operation.Method, operation.Path, body)
			if err != nil {
				return &knowledgeImportBatchFailure{
					Index:      index,
					Method:     operation.Method,
					Path:       operation.Path,
					StatusCode: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity,
					Response:   err.Error(),
				}
			}
			subrequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			subrequest.Header.Set("X-User-ID", r.Header.Get("X-User-ID"))
			subrequest.Header.Set("X-User-Role", r.Header.Get("X-User-Role"))
			response := newKnowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter()
			h.Dispatch.ServeHTTP(response, subrequest)
			if response.StatusCode() < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode() >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
				return &knowledgeImportBatchFailure{
					Index:      index,
					Method:     operation.Method,
					Path:       operation.Path,
					StatusCode: response.StatusCode(),
					Response:   strings.TrimSpace(response.body.String()),
				}
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		var failure *knowledgeImportBatchFailure
		if errors.As(err, &failure) {
			writeKnowledgeImportBatchError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "operation_failed", failure.Error(), &failure.Index)
			return
		}
		writeKnowledgeImportBatchError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "batch_failed", err.Error(), nil)
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"applied": len(request.Operations)})
}

type knowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter struct {
	header http.Header
	body   strings.Builder
	status int
}

func newKnowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter() *knowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter {
	return &knowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter{header: make(http.Header)}
}

func (w *knowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter) Header() http.Header {
	return w.header
}

func (w *knowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter) WriteHeader(status int) {
	if w.status == 0 {
		w.status = status
	}
}

func (w *knowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter) Write(payload []byte) (int, error) {
	if w.status == 0 {
		w.status = http.StatusOK
	}
	remaining := batchFailureBodyLimit - w.body.Len()
	if remaining > len(payload) {
		remaining = len(payload)
	}
	if remaining > 0 {
		_, _ = w.body.Write(payload[:remaining])
	}
	return len(payload), nil
}

func (w *knowledgeImportBatchResponseWriter) StatusCode() int {
	if w.status == 0 {
		return http.StatusOK
	}
	return w.status
}

func validateKnowledgeImportOperation(operation knowledgeImportBatchOperation) error {
	if operation.Method != http.MethodPost && operation.Method != http.MethodPut && operation.Method != http.MethodDelete {
		return fmt.Errorf("method %q is not allowed", operation.Method)
	}
	if operation.Path == "" || strings.ContainsAny(operation.Path, "?#") {
		return fmt.Errorf("path %q is not an allowlisted admin path", operation.Path)
	}
	allowed := false
	for _, pattern := range knowledgeImportWritePaths[operation.Method] {
		if pattern.MatchString(operation.Path) {
			allowed = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !allowed {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s %s is not allowed in a knowledge import batch", operation.Method, operation.Path)
	}
	body := bytes.TrimSpace(operation.Body)
	if len(body) == 0 || body[0] != '{' || !json.Valid(body) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s %s body must be a JSON object", operation.Method, operation.Path)
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		if err == nil {
			return errors.New("request body must contain one JSON document")
		}
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func writeKnowledgeImportBatchError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string, message string, index *int) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	payload := map[string]any{"error": code, "message": message}
	if index != nil {
		payload["operation_index"] = *index
	}
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}
